metrics.profile_summary: Performance Marketer and Social Media Manager with 3+ years of experience specializing in Meta Ads and lead generation. Proven track record in scaling social platforms and optimizing paid campaigns for ROI.

education.degree: Advanced Higher Diploma in Software Engineering

experience.description: Managed business operations, coordinated cross-departmental workflows, and supervised team tasks. Supported digital marketing efforts including SEO and content coordination.
Planned and managed Meta Ads campaigns for lead generation, focusing on audience research, funnel optimization, and reducing cost per lead.
Managed end-to-end social media operations, developed content calendars, and successfully monetized the company's YouTube channel within 7 months.
Created promotional video concepts and scripts aligned with brand messaging for education consultancy marketing.

strengths: Strong expertise in Meta Ads and lead generation
Proven ability to grow and monetize social channels
weaknesses: Education is in IT/Software Engineering rather than Marketing/Business
No evidence of managing marketing budgets, CAC/LTV reporting, or high-level strategy
evaluation.summary: The candidate is a strong tactical specialist in paid social and content, but lacks the seniority, educational background, and strategic management experience required for a Marketing Manager role.
